notes.title: The Kambulin Discord Server is now live!
notes.content:
[b]Now Kambulin has a Discord server![/b]
There will be the best place to always know all of the game's news, answer your questions and give feedback directly in the game's development, talking directly to the Kambulins dev (it´s only one person so be patient, your messages will be answered!). Receive notifications and don't miss any more posts about the game!


There is also space to show your work, arts or just to meet other members of the server, both in text and audio/video channels.

Join the server, be part of the community, respect everyone and, of course, have fun!

Link: https://discord.gg/M8TbFnh7
